page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a centred question heading and a paragraph beginning below it. Running head top centre, page number top left, question number "Q. VII." top right (not transcribed as running head). No margin notes, no notes below the text, no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: & ad solutionem objectionis & Quaestionis illius. Adeoq; si injuria palpabilis & planè notoria alicui illata sit, ut in Quaestionibus facti item vitae & morum evidentior esse res solet, quàm in Quaestionibus fidei, Magistratus immediatè potest prospicere conquerenti, ut factum à Principibus Iudæ;si autem injuria non sit adeò notoria, ut in Quaestionibus fidei contingere solet; debet Maigstratus operam dare, ut à majore conventu Ecclesiastico seu Synodo legitimâ res decidatur, prout in vetere Ecclesiâ secundum verbum Dei pii imperatores fecere, & Reformati Doctores semper contra Ex-communicationem Papalem contenderunt ac petierunt. Hæc omnia perspicuè & solidè pluribus deducere & ostendere possem. Ceterùm an Magistratui liceat adsidere Consistorio, videatur Synod. Dord. Constit. Eccles. art. 37. & D. D. Proff, Leydd. loco citato.
main_text.head: QUÆST. VIII. An Magistratus habeat potestatem leges ferendi Ecclesiasticas?
main_text.p: BEllarminus negat, & Magistratui tantum tribuit potestatem leges ferendi

page.notes: Top right "Q. VII." is a question number beside the running head, left out of the running head because it is a number. A small mark follows "Magistratus" in the first paragraph (possibly a reference sign); it is not transcribed, no matching note is printed. "Maigstratus" is a printing error for "Magistratus", kept as printed. "Iudæ;si" is printed without a space, kept as printed. A stray dot appears after "communicationem" in "Excommunicationem Papalem"; not transcribed. The "B" of the last paragraph is a large initial joined to "Ellarminus". The paragraph continues past the scan's last line, so it is not closed.
